mods.description:
Nerfs elytra by adding an entirely new dungeon-like dimension you need to complete to obtain one.

REQUIREMENTS:
 - Minecraft 1.21.4
 - [ETF] Entity Texture Features
 - [EMF] Entity Model Features
 - Polytone
 - MoreMcmeta (OPTIONAL)

releases.notes:
**Compatible with Minecraft 1.21.4**

- Minecraft 1.21.4 Specific 
	- Updated to 1.21.4 itemstate format 
	- Updated custom_model_data to 1.21.4 format
	- Added Resin Brick as supported trim material for Transgression Armor Trim
	- Added some new blocks from Pale Garden game drop to the necessary block tags
	- Trail particles updated to 1.21.4 format; their appearance was made more beautiful
	- Added the concept of patch_list to the updater function. This will help maintain changes that require manual update in more convenient way
- Datapack 1.0.2 Specific
	- Some tags were migrated from mmdp.deformation to mmdp general namespace
	- Added some generic block tags to mmdp namespace
	- Added version_glossary.txt to help link semantic version of the pack with pack_version value in the scoreboard
	- Were made attempts to fix and improve Ukrainian and Polish translations
	- Tweaked some probabilities in treasure_chest and usual_spawner loot tables. Getting treasure loot is now more feasible
	- Trail particles spreading now works properly in the central room
	- Custom items are now added to creative tabs for users of the datapack version as well. Previously, this feature was available by default only for mod players. In both cases, this requires Polytone mod on client side.

mods.description:
Nerfs elytra by adding an entirely new dungeon-like dimension you need to complete to obtain one.

REQUIREMENTS:
 - Minecraft 1.21.2-1.21.3
 - [ETF] Entity Texture Features
 - [EMF] Entity Model Features
 - Polytone
 - MoreMcmeta (OPTIONAL)

releases.notes:
**Compatible with Minecraft 1.21.2-1.21.3**

- Updated to Minecraft 1.21.2+ syntax
- Migrated all models from CMD to the new item_model component, enhancing compatibility and ease of development.
- Removed integration with CIT as it's now longer required
	- Due to this, CIT Resewn is no longer a required dependence for modded version
- Added an update system that will upgrade all items and outdimensional blocks from CMD to item_model component system automatically
- As there are no mods that implement CTM feature on 1.21.2-1.21.3 Neoforge (previously it was implemented by Continuity with Sinytra Connector), system for displaying textures of indimension blocks on Neoforge was migrated from **CTM** to Polytone's **Biome Variant Textures**
	- Due to this Continuity and Sinytra Connector is no longer required dependences for Neoforge version, while Polytone became mandatory
	- Note, that Polytone's **Biome Variant Textures** is less functional and several indimension blocks cannot obtain unique textures with it. It also described as experimental, more resource-intensive and less compatible with other mods by Polytone's author.
	- Because of that, migration to this system is temporal, and will be reverted when CTM mods for Neoforge become available
- Added `trail` particles to mini boss teleportations to help players - locate their teleportation destinations more easily 
- Fixed a desync (caused by MC-197855) with Watchling's special attack on loaded servers (thanks to `/rotate`)
- Updated `player_motion` library to 1.4.2 version

- All features from **1.0.1+1.21**

mods.description:
Nerfs elytra by adding an entirely new dungeon-like dimension you need to complete to obtain one.

REQUIREMENTS:
 - Minecraft 1.21.1
 - Sinytra Connector
 - Continuity (NEOFORGE version)
 - [ETF] Entity Texture Features
 - [EMF] Entity Model Features
 - CIT Resewn (FABRIC version)
 - CITResewnNeoPatcher
 - MoreMcmeta (FABRIC version) [Optional, but highly recommended]
 - Polytone (NEOFORGE version) [Optional, but highly recommended]

releases.notes:
**Compatible with Minecraft 1.21-1.21.1**

- Added Korean Translation
- Added Version System to the datapack
	- This will allow to create automatic update functions that will update required custom datapack elements without player's involvement
	- Added version system to the languages
- Changed icons of some advancements
- Tweaked rewards of some advancements
- Transgression armor trim now always generates with phantom membranes to show its duplicate item
- Fixed emissive textures of mobs don't work on Optifine
- Fixed a bug where after dimension generation some chunks may not be unloaded, resulting in dozens forceload chunks in empty dimension.
- Added a system to automatically handle the bugs like this (↑), by unloading all chunks of the empty Deformation Dimension after each reload.
- Structure related fixes:
	- Fixed mini bosses can teleport to some hard-to-reach places
	- Fixed broken painting in parkour_box_coridor/usual/3 room
	- Fixed wrong painting in one of the middle-size rooms
	- Tweaked entrance of invisible parkour boxes
- Removed wrong duplicates of custom paintings in Operator Utilities creative tab on modded version with Polytone
- Fixed Delusioner Arrows from creative tab (with Polytone) and from loot table don't stack
- Fixed not all command blocks are removed before the end of the dimension generation
- Fixed a bug with random_tick_speed 
- Fixed update checker doesn't work on Neoforge
- Tweaked license links on Quilt
